thread:
olivia_eng: Quick sync — we need a compact rollout checklist for the Optimize toolkit (batching / caching / quant recs + eval-triggered alerts) that product can share with pilot customers. Can we agree on 3 gating signals and exact acceptance criteria?
kevin_pdm: +1. My proposal: economics uplift (>5% token cost reduction without >5% quality drop), latency within SLO (p95 < target, p99 soft warn), and stable eval alerts (no >3 eval-triggered regressions per week).
sara_prod: That sounds reasonable. For customers, we should translate "quality drop" into an eval-set metric (per-cust concordance or BLEU/ROUGE for retrieval-ish tasks). Also add an operational checklist for fallback behavior.
ben_sre: Important: if we enable quant recommendations, we need an automatic fallback to a higher-precision variant on error or if latency spikes. Also require a canary with traffic cap (5% for 24h) + auto-rollback.
umar: I'll draft numeric thresholds. Suggestions: econ uplift >= 5% AND p95 latency improvement >= 10% for batching gains. Quality delta threshold: relative eval-score change <= 0.03 absolute (or 3 percentage points) on customer eval set. Eval-alert frequency threshold: <= 3/week as kevin said.
kevin_pdm: Nice. We should also make the alert config explicit so eng-ops can wire it in. For example: ```yaml
alert_eval_regressions:
  window: 7d
  max_regressions: 3
quality_delta_threshold: 0.03
```
olivia_eng: Good — add a small acceptance test: run a 24h canary with synthetic load + customer sample traffic (if available) and verify: 1) no auto-rollbacks triggered, 2) cost per 1k tokens reduced by >=5%, 3) eval delta within threshold. If any condition fails -> rollback.
sara_prod: For pilot docs, include a short customer playbook: how to opt out, how to pin a model, and how we surface alerts (Slack + PagerDuty + Email). Also specify expected false-positive rate for eval alerts and the recommended threshold tuning process.
ben_sre: One more SLO detail: p99 is allowed to drift during cold-starts, so we should measure steady-state p99 after 5m warm-up. If steady-state p99 > SLO by 20% -> rollback.
umar: Putting it together, I'll create a checklist and a tiny decision matrix: "green" if all 3 signals pass, "amber" if econ+latency pass but eval borderline (<=5 regressions/14d) -> extend canary, "red" -> rollback.
olivia_eng: Perfect. Can someone put this into an internal doc and a one-pager for customers? Link to a stub: https://docs.redwood.internal/optimize/rollout-rubric (will update).
sara_prod: I can do the one-pager. Will include example language for customers about quantization tradeoffs and how to request a manual hold on recommendations.
ben_sre: I'll add operational hooks in the runbook: canary policy, auto-rollback, and a runbook for investigating eval-alert spikes.
umar: Drafting checklist now; will post a PR by EOD.
deploy-bot: Reminder: canary window for current optimize-toolkit branch scheduled tomorrow 03:00 UTC (5% traffic). :rocket:
olivia_eng: Thanks all — ping me when the PR is up and I'll run through the acceptance checklist with product. :thumbsup:
